headline: Suboptimal peak inspiratory flow remains common in COPD over time, ERJ Open Research study reports
dek: A study in ERJ Open Research links suboptimal peak inspiratory flow in COPD to suboptimal inhaler use, according to a post by ERS publications.
body:
Suboptimal peak inspiratory flow (PIF) remains common in COPD over time and is associated with suboptimal inhaler use, according to a study published in ERJ Open Research.

The findings were summarised in a post on X by ERS publications on 12 November 2026. The post said the results highlight the need for routine PIF assessment to support personalised inhaler selection.

The post did not give details of the study design, the number of participants, the length of follow-up or the size of the association. It did not name the authors.
